label: Cabinet installation
aliases: cabinets, cabinetry, millwork, upper cabinets, lower cabinets, base cabinets, wall cabinets, gabinetes, gabinetes de arriba, gabinetes de abajo
scope_text:
# Cabinet Installation
Fabricate and install {amount}upper and lower cabinets {where}.
Provide the approved cabinet material, laminate, color, style, and finish.
Provide doors, drawers, adjustable shelves, hinges, pulls, slides, finished panels, fillers, toe kicks, and associated hardware as applicable.
Provide blocking, anchors, fasteners, supports, and reinforcement as required.
Level, align, and securely fasten the cabinets to the supporting structure.
checks:
Verify the cabinets are level, properly aligned, securely fastened, and structurally supported.
Verify cabinet doors, drawers, shelves, hinges, and hardware function as intended.

label: Solid-surface countertop
aliases: solid surface, Corian, countertop, counter, encimera, mostrador, superficie sólida
scope_text:
# Solid-Surface Countertop Installation
Fabricate and install {amount}solid-surface countertop {where}.
Provide the approved material, color, finish, thickness, and edge profile.
Provide required finished edges, seams, cutouts, supports, and reinforcement.
Level, align, and securely fasten the countertop to the supporting cabinets or support system.
Seal countertop joints, edges, seams, and wall transitions as required.
Complete fabrication and installation according to field-verified dimensions and manufacturer recommendations.
checks:
Verify the countertop is level, properly aligned, securely fastened, and adequately supported.
Verify seams, edges, cutouts, and wall transitions have a clean, uniform appearance.

label: Laminate countertop
aliases: laminate countertop, laminate counter, Formica, encimera laminada, mostrador laminado
scope_text:
# Laminate Countertop Installation
Fabricate and install {amount}laminate countertop {where}.
Provide the approved laminate color, pattern, finish, thickness, and edge treatment.
Provide required finished edges, seams, cutouts, supports, and reinforcement.
Level, align, and securely fasten the countertop to the supporting cabinets or structure.
Seal countertop joints, edges, seams, and wall transitions as required.
checks:
Verify the countertop is level, properly aligned, securely fastened, and adequately supported.
Verify the laminate surfaces, finished edges, seams, and cutouts have a clean, uniform appearance.

label: Door and frame
aliases: door and frame, metal door, wood door, hollow metal, HM door, puerta y marco, new door, puerta nueva
scope_text:
# Door & Frame Installation
Provide and install {amount}door and compatible frame {where}.
Coordinate the door type, frame depth, finish, handing, swing, and hardware preparation with the approved project specifications.
Set, level, align, anchor, and securely fasten the frame within the prepared opening.
Install compatible hinges, lockset or latchset, closer, stop, fasteners, and associated hardware as applicable.
Apply compatible sealant around the frame perimeter and adjacent transitions as required.
Adjust the door and hardware to provide proper clearances and smooth operation.
checks:
Verify the door and frame are plumb, level, properly aligned, securely fastened, and stable.
Verify the door opens, closes, latches, and clears the frame and flooring properly.
Verify the installed hardware functions smoothly and as intended.

label: Carpet
aliases: carpet, broadloom carpet, carpet roll, wall-to-wall carpet, alfombra, piso de alfombra
scope_text:
# Subfloor Preparation
Remove residual adhesive, loose materials, and surface contaminants as required.
Patch and level minor substrate imperfections to provide a suitable installation surface.
# Carpet Installation
Provide and install {amount}carpet {where}.
Provide compatible adhesive, tack strips, cushion, transitions, and installation materials as applicable.
Cut and fit the carpet neatly around walls, corners, door frames, and fixed components.
Complete seams and transitions according to manufacturer recommendations.
checks:
Verify the carpet is securely installed, properly stretched, and free of wrinkles, bubbles, or loose edges.
Verify seams, perimeter cuts, and transitions have a clean, uniform appearance.

label: Carpet tile
aliases: carpet tile, carpet squares, modular carpet, alfombra modular, losetas de alfombra, cuadros de alfombra
scope_text:
# Subfloor Preparation
Remove residual adhesive, loose materials, and surface contaminants as required.
Patch and level minor substrate imperfections to provide a suitable installation surface.
# Carpet Tile Installation
Provide and install {amount}carpet tile {where}.
Install the approved pattern and directional layout using compatible adhesive.
Cut and fit the carpet tile neatly around walls, corners, door frames, and fixed components.
Provide required transition strips and perimeter finishes.
checks:
Verify all carpet tiles are securely adhered, properly aligned, and free of raised or loose edges.
Verify the pattern, seams, perimeter cuts, and transitions have a consistent appearance.

label: Sheet vinyl flooring
aliases: sheet vinyl, roll vinyl, vinyl roll, welded flooring, heat-welded vinyl, piso de vinilo, vinilo en rollo, piso soldado
scope_text:
# Subfloor Preparation
Remove residual adhesive, loose materials, and surface contaminants as required.
Patch, smooth, and level the substrate to provide a suitable installation surface.
# Sheet Vinyl Flooring Installation
Provide and install {amount}sheet vinyl flooring {where}.
Install the flooring using compatible adhesive and installation materials per manufacturer recommendations.
Cut and fit the flooring neatly around walls, corners, door frames, penetrations, and fixed components.
Heat-weld seams and complete transitions as required for a continuous finished surface.
checks:
Verify the flooring is fully adhered, properly aligned, and free of bubbles, loose edges, or immediate tripping hazards.
Verify welded seams, perimeter cuts, and transitions are smooth, secure, and uniform.

label: Ceramic floor tile
aliases: ceramic tile, floor tile, bathroom tile, loseta, baldosa, cerámica, piso de cerámica
scope_text:
# Substrate Preparation
Clean and prepare the substrate to receive the new tile.
Patch and level minor substrate imperfections as required.
# Ceramic Tile Installation
Provide and install {amount}ceramic floor tile {where}.
Install the tile using compatible setting materials according to the approved layout.
Cut and fit the tile neatly around walls, corners, door frames, fixtures, and penetrations.
Grout the tile joints using the approved color and clean the completed surfaces.
checks:
Verify the tiles are securely installed, properly aligned, and free of loose or uneven sections.
Verify grout joints, perimeter cuts, and transitions have a clean, consistent appearance.

label: Terrazzo repair
aliases: terrazzo, terrazzo repair, patch terrazzo, terrazo, reparar terrazo, parche de terrazo
scope_text:
# Terrazzo Flooring Repair
Repair {amount}terrazzo flooring {where}.
Remove loose, cracked, or deteriorated material within the affected sections as required.
Clean and prepare the exposed repair areas to receive compatible terrazzo repair material.
Install and compact the repair material to match the adjacent flooring elevation, color, and aggregate as closely as possible.
Grind, hone, and polish the repaired sections to blend with the surrounding finish.
checks:
Verify the repaired terrazzo is secure, level, and free of loose edges or immediate tripping hazards.
Verify the repair color, aggregate, sheen, and transitions blend with the surrounding flooring as closely as possible.

label: Acoustical ceiling
aliases: acoustical ceiling, ACT, ceiling tile, ceiling grid, drop ceiling, suspended ceiling, cielo acústico, cielo falso, losetas de cielo, grid
scope_text:
# Acoustical Ceiling Installation
Provide and install {amount}acoustical ceiling tile and suspension grid system {where}.
Provide compatible main runners, cross tees, perimeter molding, hanger wires, fasteners, and accessories as required.
Lay out and install the grid to provide consistent tile placement and alignment.
Cut and fit ceiling tiles neatly around lights, diffusers, sprinklers, access panels, and other fixed components.
Coordinate ceiling elevations and penetrations with existing conditions.
checks:
Verify the ceiling grid is level, properly aligned, securely suspended, and adequately supported.
Verify ceiling tiles are seated correctly and free of broken edges, stains, or visible damage.
Verify perimeter cuts and penetrations have a clean, uniform appearance.

label: Access panel
aliases: access panel, access door, ceiling access, wall access, panel de acceso, puerta de acceso
scope_text:
# Access Panel Installation
Provide and install {amount}access panel {where}.
Prepare the opening to accommodate the approved panel dimensions and location.
Provide framing, backing, blocking, anchors, fasteners, and reinforcement as required.
Set, level, align, and securely fasten the access-panel frame.
Adjust the panel door to provide clear access and proper operation.
checks:
Verify the access panel is properly aligned, securely fastened, and stable.
Verify the panel opens, closes, and latches as intended.
Verify the perimeter transitions have a clean, finished appearance.

label: Barn door
aliases: barn door, sliding barn door, rail door, track door, puerta corrediza, puerta de granero
scope_text:
# Barn Door & Rail Installation
Provide and install {amount}barn door and rail system {where}.
Provide the approved door, track, rollers, stops, guides, handles, fasteners, and associated hardware.
Provide permanent wall backing, blocking, anchors, and reinforcement as required to support the rail system.
Level, align, and securely fasten the track to the supporting structure.
Hang and adjust the door to provide proper clearance and smooth operation.
checks:
Verify the rail system is level, properly aligned, securely anchored, and adequately supported.
Verify the door slides smoothly, remains properly guided, and stops securely at both ends.
Verify the door, hardware, and surrounding transitions have a clean, finished appearance.

label: Handrail
aliases: handrail, railing, guardrail, wall rail, grab rail, pasamanos, baranda, barandal
scope_text:
# Handrail Installation
Fabricate and install {amount}handrail {where}.
Provide the approved material, profile, color, finish, posts, brackets, base plates, anchors, fasteners, and accessories.
Provide blocking and reinforcement as required for secure attachment.
Set, level, align, anchor, and securely fasten the handrail to sound supporting surfaces.
Seal penetrations and touch up affected finishes as required.
checks:
Verify the handrail is properly aligned, securely anchored, stable, and adequately supported.
Verify posts, brackets, welds, connections, edges, and transitions have a clean, finished appearance.

label: Cabinet relamination
aliases: relaminate, laminate repair, cabinet laminate, door laminate, reface cabinets, relaminar, reparar laminado, laminar gabinetes, forrar puertas
scope_text:
# Cabinet Repair & Relamination
Repair and relaminate {amount}cabinet surfaces {where}.
Remove loose, damaged, or deteriorated laminate as required.
Repair serviceable doors, drawer fronts, panels, corners, edges, and cabinet components.
Prepare the substrate to receive the approved replacement laminate.
Apply the laminate using compatible adhesive and provide clean seams, edges, corners, and terminations.
Adjust doors, drawers, hinges, slides, and hardware for proper operation.
checks:
Verify the laminate is fully adhered and free of bubbles, loose edges, chips, or exposed substrate.
Verify repaired doors, drawers, hinges, slides, and hardware function as intended.
Verify the color, pattern, edges, seams, and transitions have a consistent appearance.

label: Countertop support
aliases: speed braces, countertop brackets, support brackets, counter support, escuadras, refuerzo de countertop
scope_text:
# Countertop Support Installation
Provide and install {amount}countertop support bracket {where}.
Provide compatible speed braces, blocking, backing, anchors, fasteners, and reinforcement as required.
Secure the supports to sound wall framing or supporting structure.
Align and space the supports to provide proper countertop elevation and load distribution.
Secure the countertop to the support system as required.
checks:
Verify each support is properly positioned, securely anchored, and adequately reinforced.
Verify the countertop is level, stable, securely fastened, and properly supported.
